subject: fix asprintf unused result warn (#2987)
reason: The change is a mechanical refactor to silence a -Wunused-result build warning: six call sites in the Lua debugger (src/modules/lua/debug_lua.c) swap asprintf+free for lm_asprintf+ValkeyModule_Free. lm_asprintf (script_lua.c:235) produces byte-identical formatted strings via vsnprintf into a ValkeyModule_Alloc buffer, and every changed allocation is freed with the matching allocator in the same function.
